notes.title: Welcome to the world of Love Make Power!
notes.content:
Love Makes Power. I believe that it will be the energy strategy for the next generation. You can get the thesis about making love in this game. If you want to keep the information up to date, just follow us on Steam. You can also follow the newest information about my other H game, Golden Axe Idol, which will be released on 7/16.
Best Regards from Mr. H Game
